module: Module (experimental, disabled) of the Dynamic Decals tool to change the shape file (.dae) onto which decals are projected. The section code exists but the registration of the "Meshes (Experimental)" section is commented out in setup: no interface is visible.
notes: sectionGui calls api.getShapepath() (different casing from api.getShapePath() used just before): probable typo that would raise an error if the section were enabled.

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: stores the tool, the API and the settings module. Registers no section (commented line).
